title: Albert Einstein
text:
Albert Einstein was born in Germany in 1879. He loved music. He played the violin. Later, he became a famous scientist.

In 1905, he wrote about a new idea about time and space. People all over the world read his ideas. He won the Nobel Prize in 1921. He died in 1955.

questions.text: What kind of person was Einstein probably?
Why were his ideas important to people?
options: They changed how people understood the world
They were only read in Germany
They were forgotten the next day

vocabulary.definition: a person who studies science as a job
a musical instrument with four strings that you play with a bow
thoughts or plans that come into your mind

paragraph_translations: Albert Einstein nasceu na Alemanha em 1879. Ele amava música. Ele tocava violino. Mais tarde, tornou-se um cientista famoso.
Em 1905, ele escreveu sobre uma nova ideia sobre tempo e espaço. Pessoas do mundo todo leram suas ideias. Ele ganhou o Prêmio Nobel em 1921. Ele morreu em 1955.
